old_description: is an industry-leading designer and manufacturer of custom human-machine interfaces and medical circuits. (aka: membrane switches,
about:
SSI Electronics was established in 1983 in Belmont, Michigan, as a spinoff of a West Michigan screen printing company. The business remains headquartered in the Grand Rapids area, with additional manufacturing facilities overseas and local representation in 15 U.S. cities.

The company designs and manufactures custom human-machine interfaces, including membrane switches, rubber keypads, touch screens, flexible circuits, graphic overlays, medical sensors, capacitive switches, and hybrid assemblies. Its capabilities span award-winning screen printing, quick-turn prototyping, full-scale production, design assistance, and supply-chain management for value-added assemblies.

SSI serves more than 300 customers across 15 industries, ranging from large medical OEMs requiring disposable circuits and sensors to small start-ups. The medical sector is a primary focus, but the company supports businesses of every size in diverse markets.

SSI emphasizes globally competitive pricing, problem-solving insights, expeditious development cycles, and first-class responsiveness. Its offshore manufacturing network, built over 15 years, provides redundant facilities, expansive capacity, and proximity to foreign assembly plants for high-volume, labor-intensive projects.

name: SSI Packaging powered by Atlantic Tape & Packaging

about:
SSI Packaging Group, operating as SSI Packaging powered by Atlantic Tape & Packaging, has been based in Richmond, Virginia since its founding in 1967. The company is locally owned and operated, serving the Mid-Atlantic and Southeast regions from its headquarters on Brook Road.

The business distributes a broad line of packaging and shipping supplies — over 20,000 items including corrugated boxes, packing tape, bubble wrap, kraft paper, void fill, poly bags, and stretch film — all stocked for same-day shipment or warehouse pickup. It also supplies marking and coding equipment such as small-character and large-character drop-on-demand inkjet printers, high-resolution inkjet printers, industrial labeling systems, and stenciling equipment, along with rental programs for coding hardware.

Customers span dozens of sectors, with the company citing food packaging and e-commerce fulfillment as primary examples. Its territory covers Virginia, Maryland, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia, supporting manufacturers, distributors, and fulfillment centers that need reliable packaging and product identification solutions.

SSI emphasizes a value proposition built on five decades of experience, a 'right product for the right solution' consulting approach, and round-the-clock technical support from both office and field teams. The firm says its differentiators are deep product knowledge, 24/7 service availability, and a commitment to keeping customers' production lines running.

about:
STR8 Sheet Fabrications LLC was founded in 2014 in Mukilteo, Washington. The business grew out of founder Will’s sheet metal career, which began in 2008, and operates as a limited liability company serving the Pacific Northwest.

The shop focuses on architectural sheet metal fabrication for construction projects. Its core output includes saddles, window and door pans, chimney caps, roof and deck scuppers, collector heads, bellyband and thru-wall flashings, window and door head flashings, parapet coping, and drip edge and wall metal. In addition to fabrication, the company provides 2D-to-3D conversion, design assistance, water intrusion analysis, site visits, field measuring, free local delivery, mock-ups, submittal packages, shop drawings for long-term projects, and installation referrals. It is also an authorized dealer for AEP Span panel products and accessories.

STR8 Sheet serves the construction industry, supplying custom flashing and sheet metal components to contractors, builders, and architects on commercial and residential building projects throughout the region.

The company emphasizes a balance of form and function, citing modern equipment and innovation to produce flashing systems. It states that customer satisfaction and speedy production are its top priorities, backed by services such as free local delivery and on-site measuring.

name: Saffron Road
old_description: Enter your phone number and email below to unlock our exclusive in-store offer!
about:
Saffron Road is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, and was founded in 2010 by Adnan Durrani, a 30-year veteran of the organic food sector. Durrani launched the brand nationally in July 2010 at Whole Foods Market as the world's first Halal-certified, antibiotic-free, and humanely raised frozen entrée line, aiming to create a premium better-for-you brand that honored environmental, farmer, animal, and health standards without compromising taste.

The company produces a range of globally inspired frozen meals, snacks, and sauces, including frozen dinners with at least 50% more chicken or lamb, crunchy chickpea snacks, single-serve simmer sauces, and frozen world-cuisine wraps. Its product portfolio spans over six world cuisines and is positioned as the fastest-growing natural frozen entrée brand and the chickpea snack brand in the natural channel. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed in the available information.

Saffron Road's products are sold through major natural and conventional grocery retailers such as Whole Foods Market, Target, Sprouts Farmers Market, and Safeway, reaching consumers seeking clean-label, ethically sourced convenience foods. Customer testimonials cite purchases at these retailers across states including Texas, California, Georgia, Virginia, New York, and Florida.

The company frames its mission as connecting cultures through food while maintaining purpose beyond profit.

name: Saginaw Bay Plastics Inc
old_description: Saginaw Bay Plastics Inc. is a global provider of injection molded plastic parts since 1978
about:
Saginaw Bay Plastics Inc. was founded in 1978 in Kawkawlin, Michigan, as a family‑owned business that evolved from a tool and die operation into a specialist in thermoplastic injection molding.

The company operates injection molding machines ranging from 101 to 1,461 tons and offers two‑shot molding, sequential valve gate controls, sub‑assembly, pad printing, hot stamping, and inkjet barcoding. It processes a range of thermoplastics including polycarbonate, ABS, nylons, polyesters, polypropylene, and glass‑ or mineral‑filled grades. Production is supported by in‑house tool repair, dedicated robots, camera vision inspection, end‑of‑arm tooling, and an ERP system (IQMS) with EDI capability. A just‑in‑time inventory program helps customers reduce stock on hand, and an experienced engineering team collaborates on tooling design for maximum quality and efficiency.

Its primary customers are Tier 1 automotive suppliers for interior components such as headliners, armrests, and panels. The firm also serves the agriculture, marine, and commercial sectors.

Saginaw Bay Plastics emphasizes collaboration and forward‑thinking engineering, performing design of experiments, APQP, PFMEA, and PPAP validation before launch to ensure quality parts delivered on time. The company’s motivation is to provide innovative solutions through collaboration and forward thinking, and it prides itself on its employees and on‑time delivery of quality parts.

The inventory spans thousands of SKUs, and the showroom features a video tour for remote browsing. Financing options, including a one-year no-interest program, are available.

name: Salt Road Food Hub
old_description: Use our strictly gluten-free, vegetarian facility to make your products — or have our team make them for you. Join a community of small food producers in Northern New Jersey.
about:
Salt Road Food Hub operates a strictly gluten-free, vegetarian food manufacturing facility at 255 West Broadway in Paterson, New Jersey. The hub provides shared kitchen space and co-packing services for small-scale food entrepreneurs, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The 10,000-square-foot building includes 4,000 square feet of production space equipped with a Revent double rack oven, 60-quart Hobart mixers, a proofer, sheeter, tilt skillets (40- and 30-gallon), a 30-gallon steam kettle, Robot Coupes (65-, 44-, and 23-quart), piston and bottle fillers, sealing machines, a vibratory filler, walk-in cooler and freezer, an air-conditioned warehouse, and a walk-in drying room for low-temperature dehydration. A staff of three supports both shared-kitchen users and full co-packing runs.

Clients range from pre-revenue founders testing products to established brands seeking flexible East Coast production without owning a facility. Notable users include Full of Beans Kitchen and a tempeh producer who has manufactured for 15 years. The hub also serves brands based outside the region that need New York metropolitan area production, as well as retailers and meal services requiring branded production runs.

Salt Road distinguishes itself by bundling USDA Organic and IKC Kosher certification support, direct distribution, and Amazon FBA management alongside its manufacturing services. The company positions itself as a community that provides expertise on company setup, equipment sourcing, and online marketing in addition to physical production capacity.

name: Same Sun Of Vermont Inc
old_description: Solar solutions for homes and businesses, designed to maximize energy generation, while looking good on your roof, garage, yard or other location.
about:
Same Sun of Vermont was founded in 2011 in Rutland, Vermont, by Marlene and Philip Allen. The couple, a former commercial real estate appraiser and fine art dealer, had installed a rooftop array on their own home and decided to turn their experience into a family-owned business. They opened a ground-level storefront with the goal of using American-made products and creating local jobs to establish solar energy as a “new normal” in the region.

The company designs and installs custom solar arrays for residential, commercial, and institutional clients, and also provides EV charging station installation, ongoing service, maintenance, and repair. In 2018 it expanded to a 3,000-square-foot facility on West Street that features a solar awning, battery storage, and a dual EV charger. The team includes a NABCEP-certified technical sales specialist, a master electrician, and dedicated installation crews.

Same Sun serves homeowners, businesses, schools, and non-profits across Vermont, New Hampshire, and New York. Project examples include installations for VMS Construction, The Royal Group, Otter Valley Union High School, Weston Priory, and the Tunbridge Solar array in Benson and Royalton, as well as numerous residential roof and ground mounts.

The Allens started the business to empower property owners to generate their own energy and to keep young Vermonters in the state with good-paying work. The company emphasizes attention to detail, superior customer service, and sourcing premium components to ensure long-term system performance.

name: SanTan Solar
old_description: Build your complete, custom solar system with our extensive inventory of panels, inverters, and batteries for every project and budget size.
about:
SanTan Solar is based in Gilbert, Arizona, in the southeast valley of Phoenix. Founded in 1999 as a family-owned business, the company took its name from the nearby SanTan Mountain, a desert peak known for intense sunshine and high temperatures. The founders are not identified in the available sources.

The company operates as a solar equipment distributor, stocking an extensive inventory of new and used solar panels, inverters, batteries, mounting hardware, and complete solar kits from brands such as Canadian Solar, EG4, and K2. It provides custom system design, financing options through partners like Affirm, PayPal, and Figure HELOC, and lifetime technical support for DIY customers and professional installers. A customer review describes the Gilbert facility as massive with a streamlined will-call pickup process.

SanTan Solar serves residential and commercial solar markets, off-grid enthusiasts, and professional installers across the United States. Its customer base includes homeowners building custom arrays, contractors sourcing EG4 batteries and K2 racking, and DIYers seeking affordable used panels for seasonal use.

The company’s stated mission is to make energy independence accessible by offering solar products for any budget. It differentiates itself through family-owned values, transparent pricing, dedicated pre- and post-purchase support, and a focus on both DIY and installer-friendly service.
